request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 in Tunis lost all service for a few hours yesterday evening. What happened? Now: 2026-09-03 09:00 (Thursday, Africa/Tunis). Data after this time does

parsed.title: Transport Fiber Link Outage Affecting Sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002
parsed.root_cause_summary: A fiber loss of signal on the shared transport link LNK-TUN-01-A caused a complete service outage for sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002.
parsed.confidence_reason: The direct cause (LINK_LOS) is evidenced on the shared fiber link at the exact onset of the incident. Changes, maintenance, and external events were all checked and ruled out via T5, T6, and T7.
parsed.impact_summary: Sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 suffered a complete loss of service and availability drop for 4 hours from 2026-09-02 18:00 to 2026-09-02 22:00.

timeline.event: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on shared fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A.
Traffic, active users, and availability drop detected on S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002.
Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-TUN-001 below LNK-TUN-01-A.
LINK_LOS on LNK-TUN-01-A and SITE_DOWN on S-TUN-001 cleared, restoring site services.

findings.claim: Sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 experienced an active users, availability, and traffic drop starting at 2026-09-02 18:00 and ending at 2026-09-02 22:00.
Both sites depend on the same parent fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A, aggregation router AGG-TUN-01, and core upf CORE-UPF-01.
A critical LINK_LOS alarm occurred on LNK-TUN-01-A at 2026-09-02 18:00 and cleared at 2026-09-02 22:00.
No changes or maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected nodes or their ancestors during the incident window.
No external events were recorded for the TUN region during the incident window.
The transport link failure directly caused both downstream sites to lose connectivity.

hypotheses.reason: Direct evidence of a fiber loss of signal (LINK_LOS) on LNK-TUN-01-A matches the precise start and end times of the site service drops, with no competing changes or maintenance.
Change management tools show no configuration changes applied to the nodes or their parents during the window.
Maintenance logs show no scheduled maintenance windows on the affected nodes or their parents during the window.

dismissed_signals.reason: Relates to site S-SFX-001 in region SFX on the following day (2026-09-03), unrelated to the Tunis sites incident.

recommended_actions: Inspect the physical fiber path for LNK-TUN-01-A to determine the underlying cause of the temporary loss of signal.
